name: coverage-compliance
objective: Coverage recette for the compliance domain: the privileged role compliance_admin exercises every one of its 1 catalogued actions, asserting the documented posture (0 allow, 1 escalate, 0 deny). Proves the catalog/engine emit the right verdict for each action of this domain.
teaching: The compliance_admin gets a verdict matching the risk, never a blanket grant: a low-risk routine action is allowed (least-privilege), a sensitive action escalates to a human (I6), a pure-deny action stays denied for everyone. The whole sweep is replayable for audit (I4).

agents.system_prompt: You are the privileged compliance_admin agent for the compliance system.

actions.rationale: MEDIUM action; privileged role compliance_admin -> escalate (human approval gate).
